cands.name: Tim Melson

money.note: Covers January 2023 on, primary and general. Party-committee lines are often in-kind staff and mail.
money.source: Alabama Fair Campaign Practices Act system, downloaded Nov 5, 2026

cands.bio: Physician and business owner from Florence. Former chief of anesthesia at Helen Keller Hospital and owner of Shoals Medical Trials. Republican member of the Alabama Senate for District 1 since 2014. He chairs the Senate Healthcare Committee and sponsored the state's medical cannabis law.
cands.gaps: We found no documented statements or actions by Melson on data centers, development or growth, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor ownership of land, H-1B or immigration enforcement, police pay, or school choice and teacher pay. His pro-life and gun positions come from a general campaign description, not specific bills, and no 'no exceptions' stance was found. No endorsements were listed for 2026. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. His exact birthplace within Alabama was not stated.

qual.background: Alabama state senator since 2014, with service on finance and taxation committees. Former anesthesiologist, chief of anesthesia at Helen Keller Hospital from 1993 to 2008, and owner of the clinical-trials business Shoals Medical Trials.
qual.why: He has 12 years of legislative service, including work on budget and tax-related committees, plus a business-owner background. Committee chairmanships were not counted toward the score.

second-amendment.evidence: During his 2018 reelection campaign he described himself as someone who would uphold conservative ideals, including pro-gun and Second Amendment protections. He is also an NRA member.

pro-life.evidence: During his 2018 reelection campaign he said he would uphold conservative ideals, including anti-abortion measures.
